question: Can unchanged-physics public reward configuration and longer real interactions yield sufficient action-consequence feedback on an independently admitted POMDP source?
hypothesis: 256 genuine source actions and publicly available failure-reward feedback should reveal more real feedback than FKP10's 32-step random probes, without altering observed transitions. This may still fail to show enough useful positive learning signal.
predecessors: FKP10 PR #1100 source qualification run #43725716616, original 970100..970103 consumed, 256 total env.step and only two nonzero rewards
FKP09 PR #1101 genuine shared-core engineering PASS but prediction exactly tied Bayesian and sparse conventional; SCIENCE NO_GO

frozen_design.upstream: MarcoMeter/endless-memory-gym MIT original source git a94f2b60d1769ea44df3226561488768e1dff9f4 and FKP10 five pinned blobs. Python3.11 gymnasium==0.29.0 pygame==2.4.0 numpy==1.26.4; source untouched.

seeds.dev: 971100..971103 new public DEV, disjoint from consumed FKP10 970100..970103
seeds.fixture: fake public observations, no original episode

action_policy.random: rng random.Random(seed XOR 0xF11A1) each of two symbols 0..2 each step
action_policy.macro8: rng random.Random(seed XOR 0xF11B2) two symbols drawn once every 8 steps, repeated during block

reset_conditions.public_failure_feedback: reward_command_failure=-0.05 for MortarMayhem; reward_fall_off=-0.05 for MysteryPath. Both native source reset options change reward only, must verify same paired public action/observation and termination. Not official task score.

frozen_design.ordering: Commit prereg first; source/learner frozen and G29 full Linux+Windows root and fixture tests PASS before original public DEV. On Linux one original public DEV; Windows is replay of consumed DEV, not new scientific source. Always same public actions per task/seed/policy between reward modes. Never use env.unwrapped or info fields or hidden labels.
frozen_design.data_budget: 2 tasks x4 seeds x2 source-blind policies x2 rewards =32 original upstream episodes, maximum 256 genuine env.step each, <=8192 actual steps; same-action paired observations.
frozen_design.evaluator: Seal action/observation/termination trace per paired condition. Compare equality 16/16 pairs, actual public rewards, positive/negative/nonzero events, length, 32-vs-256 feedback, distinct observation SHA. No hidden task state access.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python3.11, pinned original standard public deps, G29 + root regression on two OS; only existing GitHub hosted test route, no paid API; wall/cpu recorded.
frozen_design.headroom_thresholds: Source HEADROOM PASS (feasibility only): 16/16 pair transition equality; >=16 additional public nonzero feedback events PER TASK over matched original reward config; >=4 of 8 policy-seed episodes per task get >=2 nonzero public feedback events; at least 2 distinct observation frames/task. Positive rewards reported separately and absence fails positive-learning-readiness but not source mechanics.

controls: Unmodified default reward with identical seeds/actions
Original upstream reward-only public configured failure feedback
Fixed per-step random and 8-step macro source-blind action policies
Historical FKP10 32-step receipt for comparison only, never re-consume
metrics: 32 actual source episodes ≤256 steps, positive/negative/nonzero feedback by task/policy/config and reward sums
16 paired public action/observation/termination SHA-256 exact matches
Source-only feasibility, not model improvement or generalization; cross-OS deterministic reproduction
Whole-process wall/CPU and actual action cost, no hidden simulator state

Future learning science requires fully trained equal-information recurrent GRU and native candidate, untouched original benchmark task, matched actions/compute, cold retention/interference/transfer, owner first-use

classification_rules.supported: SOURCE_HEADROOM_PASS source feasibility only if prespecified counts + paired dynamics + Linux Windows exact replay
classification_rules.mixed: SOURCE_MIXED partial signal/positive reward still sparse; do not assert learner ready
classification_rules.negative: SOURCE_NO_GO if not enough events or transition differences; do not retune
classification_rules.invalid: Unfrozen labels/seed/budget, private hidden info, repeat consumed as virgin, missing exact qualification

prohibited_after_primary_run: No post-result threshold, policy, reward or seed changes
No native main, controller, scheduler or runner changes
No claim of trained intelligence or strong-control superiority
preregistration_note: No first-use outside public DEV. Freeze entire source and code before source exposure.
